name: Benjamin Yang
bio: Benjamin Yang studies international affairs at George Washington University's Elliott School. He founded Indo-Pacific Record and leads its research direction, editorial standards, and official-source monitoring systems.

name: Dylan Tanzi
bio: Dylan Tanzi supports editorial review and source-grounded regional research for Indo-Pacific Record, including work on the publication's Briefs.

name: Christin Sawyer
bio: Christin Sawyer supports the presentation and communication of Indo-Pacific Record's research, including accessible visual explainers and publication updates.
